name: Pounce
blurb: Passive: Killing an enemy or using Pounce's  Hunted bonus will  reduce Pounce's cooldown.

effects.description: Passive: Killing an enemy while in Cougar Form or using Pounce's Hunt bonus reduces Pounce's current cooldown to a minimum value.
Active: Nidalee leaps a fixed distance in the target direction. Upon arrival, she deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
Hunted Bonus: Nidalee can perform Pounce from an increased range on a Hunted enemy closest to the cursor. She will leap to the front of the target.
Takedown and Aspect of the Cougar can be cast during the dash.

notes:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Pounce will not receive the reduced cooldown if the target becomes  Hunted mid-air.
Casting Pounce on a Hunted target will extend the remaining duration of their  Hunted debuff by 1.5 seconds, up to the original duration.
